actions.action: Enter the selected realm using an issued publisher session; a second login can disconnect the first client.
Send a serverBean string and receive a status; no player-facing purpose established.
Load your private character snapshot: bag, gear, weapons, pets, cards, job, stage, quests and more. There is no target player ID.
Send a heartbeat and receive server time and time-zone offset.
Change nickname and gender in the name editor; the rename fee depends on prior changes.
Inspect a character's visible player card by ID, including displayed stats and loadout; not their private bag.
Query the Tencent SDK report timestamp; not a gameplay reward or account export.
Submit contact details to exclusive customer service; reply can include a reward. Personal information.
Retrieve the character's previously submitted customer-service contact details. Personal information.
Save tutorial or guide-step progress.
Resume a dropped game connection with the game's reconnect token, not the publisher login token.
Change the character's gender; distinct from the name editor's combined nickname/gender request.
Create a character on a realm with a nickname and gender; not required for an existing character.
Query the signed-in character's equipment, slots, dismantle settings and active enchant scheme.
Put a specific piece of equipment in a gear slot.
Spend enhancement materials to strengthen a gear slot once or towards a target level.
Attempt a gear-slot refinement with materials; protection is an explicit option.
Dismantle selected equipment IDs for materials; the equipment is removed.
Set auto-dismantle criteria, including quality and power thresholds.
Activate an eligible refine mastery (resonance) tier.
Reroll enchantments for a slot and category; locks affect the cost.
Lock or unlock an enchantment attribute line before rerolling.
Set the desired enchant attributes for a slot and category.
Summon an elite monster for gear drops using the configured item cost; supports a multi-drop multiplier.
Request elite-summon rewards. The inspected summon UI also receives rewards directly from 4061.
Pay the configured upgrade materials to advance an Elite Summon strengthening step.
Start the timed Elite Summon level upgrade after its strengthening steps are complete.
Shorten the Elite Summon upgrade timer using items, or after a rewarded ad within its allowance.
Switch to another saved enchantment scheme.
Activate an eligible enhancement mastery (resonance) tier.
Preview the power difference between two pieces of equipment without equipping them.
List items in the signed-in character's bag.
Use bag items, including selected or random chests and idle-yield buffs; contents/count can be consumed.
Query recoverable power and its last recovery time; not the character's battle-power score.
Check the available online idle reward count before requesting a payout.
Collect online idle rewards against accrued reward intervals and kills.
List unlocked profile portraits and head frames.
Set the profile portrait shown to other players.
Collect Quick Idle income; the UI selects a free allowance, ticket or diamond cost depending on current state.
Inspect idle-yield bonus state without claiming the income.
Fetch inbox messages and attachment state; this does not collect the attachments.
Collect attachments from an individual message or use the mailbox's Claim All.
Delete messages; the mailbox UI offers bulk deletion of eligible received mail.
Mark one or more messages as read; this is not the read-only inbox fetch.
List the character's profile head frames.
Equip an unlocked profile head frame.
Unlock a head frame; its configured requirement may include an item cost.
Redeem an exchange code for prizes; this consumes a redemption, not a reward preview.
Buy a shop listing in a chosen quantity; price and free/ad eligibility depend on the listing.
Buy a stage pack by pack entry; the message alone does not specify its price.
Initiate a real-money recharge order; the reply supplies the order ID for the separate publisher payment flow.
Collect an unlocked first-recharge reward; this does not perform the recharge.
Claim a cumulative recharge milestone reward at the specified grade.
Collect eligible season/battle pass rewards; the ordinary claim path uses buyLevel = 0.
Pay for a recharge product with in-game vouchers instead of opening platform checkout.
Buy a currently available triggered gift with diamonds or items; its real-money variant uses the recharge flow.
Claim daily rewards from an eligible monthly card.
Report a task-progress event by requirement type and count; this is not a reward claim.
Claim an eligible task reward and update its activity counters.
Claim an eligible daily task activity-score reward.
Report progress for specific task entries, including batched entries.
Extend an eligible time-limited quest using its configured extension cost.
Skip guild-task progress after rewarded-ad completion, within the remaining skip allowance.
Claim an eligible weekly task activity-score reward.
Claim a Carnival task activity-score reward.
Claim the reward for a completed time-limited quest.
Collect the monthly-card page's daily free reward, separate from cardholder rewards.
Poll for a GMT message after a server notification; the reply is a success flag, not message contents.
Claim an eligible guild daily-task activity-score reward.
View the campaign-stage leaderboard and your own rank entry.
Get recommended players to invite for a team type and stage, excluding specified players.
Create a team PvE room for a dungeon stage.
Join an existing team by room code or from its invitation.
Leave the current team.
Remove a player from the room; the client checks that you are the host.
Disband a team, closing the room for its members.
Auto-join from a list of pending, unexpired team invitations.
Queue the team for matchmaking on an unlocked dungeon stage.
Cancel the team's matchmaking queue.
Accept or decline a proposed match before the ready check expires.
Choose the dungeon stage for the room as its host.
Toggle your own assist-only participation in team PvE.
Send a channel message, private message or emote; chat limits apply.
Subscribe to chat channels and request their history (zone, server, guild and team invites).
Read the character's saved chat-filter settings.
Save chat filters such as minimum level or filtering strangers.
Broadcast a team recruitment message or invite selected players to a stage.
List blocked players.
Block a player.
Unblock a player.
List the character's friends.
Send a friend request to a player.
Remove a player from the friend list.
Get suggested players to add as friends.
List incoming friend requests.
Accept or reject pending friend requests; the UI can submit multiple IDs.
Find candidate players by nickname or character ID; select a server and ID before requesting the detailed card.
Open your guild overview, including its hall members.
Found a guild with a name, badge and recruitment policy; creation can cost diamonds or an item.
Look up a guild by ID or search by name.
Apply to a guild or join immediately if it allows it; the UI checks the post-leave cooldown.
List applicants awaiting guild admission.
Approve or refuse guild applications, including batch decisions where permitted.
Quit your guild, or expel a lower-ranking member if your guild role allows it.
Edit guild name, badge, join policy, notice or recruitment slogan with permission; renaming can cost diamonds.
Get the guild member roster and roles.
Browse the list of guilds.
Change a member's guild role; assigning the president role transfers leadership.
Disband the guild for everyone; the UI presents a president-only control and confirmation.
Read the guild activity log.
Donate to the guild for rewards: free, ad-backed or diamond-funded depending on the option and remaining allowance.
View today's Guild Bargain deal, including its current price.
Cut the Guild Bargain price or buy the deal; the buy branch pays the current price unless it is zero.
Send a guild recruitment invitation; the request does not name a target player.
View Guild Hunt boss state and progress.
Add to the Guild Hunt boss buff count; the request does not specify how the use is earned.
View guilds ranked by battle power.
Quick-join an available guild; the UI checks the post-leave cooldown.
Start a Guild Hunt boss fight.
Settle an existing Guild Hunt fight with its fight ID, run statistics, score and stage damage.
Sweep Guild Hunt for rewards using an eligible sweep opportunity.
View individual Guild Hunt scores and your own placement.
Submit signed/encrypted platform Game Club data and receive club data entries; SEA player workflow not identified.
Claim an eligible Guild Hunt score reward.
Inspect guild technology and research state.
Start the next guild skill research level in an available slot; configured research material costs may apply.
Speed up guild research with acceleration items or via the official rewarded-ad flow.
Claim the reward for an eligible feature preview.
View Guild Hunt scores grouped by guild rather than by player.
Open a Guild Hunt loot chest and collect its rewards.
Activate an eligible character title.
Equip a title or remove the displayed title.
List outstanding guild help requests and today's assist-reward count.
Request guild help speeding up skill research or an Elite Summon upgrade.
Help a guildmate with a specific outstanding request.
Opt in to or out of WeChat offline notifications; SEA client availability not established.
Check guild help cooldowns, daily counts and remaining research or Elite Summon upgrade time.
Select a new job or advance to a qualifying career tier.
Switch the active career specialization to an unlocked build.
Commit skill-point allocations to raise skills in a career build.
Request advancement for a career stage; the observed job-transfer UI uses the separate career-change command.
Commit available attribute points to selected stats in the current build.
Reset the current build's allocated attribute points for reassignment.
Save the ordered skill loadout for the build (including empty slots); this does not cast a combat skill.
Activate an eligible awakening tier for the character.
View the zone battle-power leaderboard and your placement.
View the server battle-power leaderboard and your placement.
Give a thumbs-up to a player on the battle-power leaderboard.
List your weapons and identify the equipped one.
Activate weapons using collected copies; the quick-activate button requests all eligible qualities.
Equip an activated weapon by quality.
Raise the star rank of a weapon using copies of that quality.
Claim an earned Weapon Master achievement reward.
Draw weapons; normal draws use the selected cost and there are separate free and ad draw modes.
Claim earned weapon-summon level rewards.
Bulk star-up already activated weapons with spare copies (the Quick Awaken confirmation).
Swap your fighting pet with the pet in a selected guard slot.
View your pet roster and formation.
Activate one pet using enough copies of that pet.
Level up a selected pet using copies.
Draw pets; normal draws use the selected cost and there are separate free and ad draw modes.
Activate all pets for which you have the required copies.
Level up eligible pets in bulk using their copies.
Deploy a pet as your fighting pet, or clear the fighting slot.
Assign a pet to a guard position, or clear that position.
Claim earned pet-summon level rewards.
Apply the one-click pet formation, updating the fighting pet and roster assignments.
View your own card collection, equipped slots and collection-bonus progress.
Activate one card when you have enough copies.
Spend copies to raise one activated card's star rank.
Activate eligible cards in bulk using copies.
Raise star ranks of eligible cards in bulk using copies.
Insert a chosen card into an equipment card slot.
Remove the card from a chosen equipment slot.
Claim earned card collection bonuses.
Combine shards of a selected card into card copies.
View your unlocked costume pieces, equipped appearance and collection progress.
Unlock a costume piece; depending on the piece, this uses an item or requires a career tier or weapon quality.
Equip an unlocked costume piece.
Remove the equipped costume piece in a selected category.
Check online status for player IDs; the private-chat list batches up to 50 per call.
Fetch a saved fight report for an arena replay using its report ID and client build.
View your Collection Gear inventory, equipped slots and enhancement state.
Spend shards to activate one Collection Gear piece.
Spend shards to raise the star rank of one active Collection Gear piece.
Activate eligible Collection Gear pieces in bulk using shards.
Star up eligible Collection Gear pieces in bulk using shards.
Combine shards for a selected Collection Gear piece.
Equip a Collection Gear piece in a compatible slot; the UI checks career and base level.
Unequip the Collection Gear piece in a selected slot.
Spend enhancement materials to upgrade an equipped slot, not the piece itself.
Enhance eligible equipped slots in bulk using enhancement materials.
Claim an earned Collection Gear collection bonus.
Switch the active card-slot preset.
Rename one enchant, card, pet or Collection Gear preset.
Switch the active pet formation preset.
Switch the active Collection Gear preset.
Apply a combined loadout set across enchantments, cards, pets and Collection Gear.
Rename a combined loadout set.
Check progress and counts for a selected Collection Gear summon pool.
Draw from a common or career Collection Gear pool; normal draws use tickets and the UI also offers an ad mode.
Claim earned draw-progress rewards for the selected Collection Gear pool.
Read the character's saved push-notification preferences.
Save push-notification preferences; the client sets the idle-reward notification toggle here.
Claim the one-time review-prompt reward; opening the platform review screen is a separate SDK action.
Retrieve a list of team IDs; the reply is not a roster of team members.
Challenge a campaign stage; receive the fight ID and simulation arguments.
Settle that campaign fight with its ID, stage and battle statistics; the reply contains the outcome, progress and any rewards.
Sweep a resource stage for rewards rather than playing the fight.
Enter a resource-stage challenge and obtain its fight ID and arguments.
Settle the resource-stage fight; first-clear and ordinary rewards are separate in the reply.
Request a bulk sweep by resource type rather than sweeping a single stage.
View Baphomet's HP ratio, your best score, tier, rank and weekly settlement time.
Start a world-boss challenge and receive the fight ID and simulation arguments.
Settle the world-boss fight with the damage dealt; receive the score, rank and rewards.
View the world-boss leaderboard and your own placement.
View MVP challenge records, including cleared difficulty and sweep progress.
Challenge an MVP at a selected difficulty stage.
Settle the MVP fight and update the challenge record; new clears can return first-clear rewards.
Sweep an eligible MVP stage for the requested count; the reply reports how many daily sweeps were used.
View current and next floor, daily challenges and sweeps, and whether a fight is still unsettled.
Start the next tower challenge; the response identifies the floor and fight.
Settle a tower floor. The reply can end the run or supply fight data for the next floor.
Sweep the tower for rewards using the selected sweep type; free and rewarded-ad allowances are tracked separately.
View Endless Tower rankings and your own entry.
Open the arena overview: score, tier, rank, season timing, allowances and top players.
Challenge an arena opponent, including a counterattack linked to a report. The start reply can already contain the result.
Submit an arena fight completion. A send method exists; normal arena settlement in this build displays the cached start result.
Refresh the opponent list. The UI enforces a refresh allowance, season check and cooldown.
Buy a specified number of arena tickets; not the command to start a challenge.
Claim eligible arena score awards and update reward times.
Request arena match candidates; this is separate from challenging an opponent or rerolling the list.
View the arena score leaderboard and your own entry.
View recent arena battle logs; the UI separately clears its local new-record indicator.
Start a team PvE stage. The direct reply is empty; team fight notifications carry further state.
Fetch the fight ID and simulation arguments for a team dungeon by team ID.
Settle the dungeon fight and receive updated personal team-PvE data, reward type and rewards.
Request the team PvE item allowance; the body has a use_diamond option, so this is not unconditionally free.
Claim eligible team-dungeon achievement rewards.
View team PvE rankings and your own entry.
Check which listed players have unlocked a dungeon stage, optionally checking online status.
Claim event-task rewards for a selected event and group.
Buy a listing in an activity shop, by event and goods entry.
Request an activity reward with event-specific arguments.
Claim a sign-in reward by entry; receive the updated sign-in state.
Unlock a sign-in activity using its configured item purchase; the cash variant goes through recharge instead.
Draw from a summon activity; count, free and rewarded-ad variants depend on the event and eligibility.
Claim a summon event's earned score rewards.
Buy a quantity of goods in the summon-event shop.
Draw on the film-summon wheel using an eligible rewarded ad or the account's ad-skip benefit.
Claim an earned film-summon progress reward.
Development fight test that returns fight arguments; not an ordinary player action.
General GM console operation; not a player command interface.
Equipment-specific GM operation; not normal equipment management.
Administrative adjustment of one task's progress; distinct from normal progress reporting.
Recharge test operation, not a player purchase or proof of payment.
Refresh data for the GM interface, not the normal character bootstrap.
Inspect diagnostic attribute and battle-power calculations.
Update tasks by class in the GM tools, not an ordinary claim.
Start a test PvP simulation for chosen players, not normal arena matchmaking.
